observation.source_interface: mncs-environment campaign evidence and committed Git source

outcome.analysis_limit: The source review establishes an attribution field was omitted; it does not establish that an agent misattributed this record or that the omission recurred.

related_work.work_intent_goal: Mature mncs-compiler for reliable native multi-module application development while advancing verified self-consumption
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

pressure_hypothesis.title: The capability projection omits the recorder when it differs from the work being observed
pressure_hypothesis.basis: One committed Compiler campaign-state observation has distinct recorder and target-work sessions; the prior projection source emitted related_work without the recorder context.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose the observation recorder's campaign, session, and consumer separately from the campaign and work intent under observation, while preserving the exact evidence pointer and treating consumer identity as recorded metadata.
not_measured: whether this omission caused a user to misattribute an observation
frequency of cross-session observations without recorder context
time, token, or resource cost attributable to the omission

supporting_sources.observed_contract: projected observation retained related_work but did not expose the record recorder context

not_measured: recurrence of missing capture attribution in other agent sessions
whether the omission changed decisions or duplicated work
whether a later recorder-context projection reduces misattribution
